title: 第二十八章    王玄
content_zh:
前方缓缓走来了两个人，挡住了琼霄两人的去路。两人一前一后，但两人身形有些不成正比，后者有着壮硕的身躯，一头短发，双目有些呆滞且面目有些古板。而前者则有一头长发，修长的身躯，虽说有着清秀的面庞但目光有些犀利阴狠。

    “你们是谁？为何要阻挡我们的去路！”琼霄冷冷道。

    “呵呵，孤陋寡闻就是孤陋寡闻，我们是谁都不知道？”那面目清秀的人讥笑道。

    “你想怎样？”琼霄面无表情的问道，眼神越发的冰冷。

    “你不该和她走的那么近！和她走的太近是要付出一定代价的！”那人淡淡的笑道。

    “哦！是吗？你确定你有这些本事？”琼霄嘲讽道。

    “琼霄，此人是风云榜上第十王玄！”李朗终于认出了他，旋即提醒道。

    “哦？风云榜第十，王玄？”琼霄问道。

    “嗯！”李朗点头道。

    “终于有人认出了我啊！”王玄盯着琼霄笑道。

    “原来是风云榜第十啊，在下的确有些失敬了！”琼霄拱手道。

    “呵呵，既然知道是我了，那应该知道我的本事了，”王玄满脸的笑意，只不过这笑意有着令人甚得慌。

    “你的意思是这事必须要有个结果了，同样是星辰帝国人，你何必要苦苦相逼呢？”琼霄十指交织在一起问道。

    王玄满脸笑意的点了点头，看着来势汹汹的王玄，琼霄不禁摇了摇头“红颜祸水啊！”

    “想要结果，我琼霄可要是不愿意呢！”

    “呵呵一个连风云榜都上不去的人，有什么资格跟我说不愿意，难道我有跟你商量了么？”王玄冷笑道。

    “风云榜？那东西我不在乎，至于有没有资格，你来试试就知道了！”琼霄面无表情道。

    “呵呵，我等会就让你知道什么叫做生不如死，学院里禁止杀人，不过，折磨人那还是可以的！”王玄淡漠的看着琼霄。

    “李朗！那个大个子你打的过吗？”眼看着要动手了，琼霄转头向李朗问道。

    “嘿嘿，那大个子是虽说是**境后期，但我总感觉他比我所遇到的**境后期还强很多，虽然赢不了他，不过，拖住他，应该还是可以的！”李朗点头道。

    “哈哈！那好，就让我俩兄弟来看看这新生风云榜有多少含金量！”琼霄大笑一声。

    随着琼霄一伙人剑拔弩张的对峙，引来了众多的学员，他们很好奇，这些人到底要干什么，不一会琼霄他们周围就围满了人。

    “咦，这不是新生风云榜第十，王玄吗？他想做什么？他的所盯着的人又是谁？风云榜貌似没有他！”人群中突然冒出一句话。

    “管他有没有在风云榜上，总之在我们新生中能敢挑战前十的人，肯定有些实力，”又有人说道。

    “琼霄，你不是我的对手，乖乖投降，以免受苦！”王玄面目狰狞的说道。

    “哼！从小到大，我就没有退缩过，想要我认输，这不可能，要战便战，别再那里啰嗦！我没有时间陪你玩！”琼霄漠然道。

    “找死！阿狼，那个小子身旁的人交给你了，迅速解决他！”王玄露出了残忍的目光。
content_en:
Two people slowly walked forward, blocking the way of Qiong Xiao and the others. The two were one behind the other, but their statures were somewhat disproportionate. The latter had a strong body, short hair, dull eyes and a somewhat rigid face. The former has long hair, a slender body, and although he has a delicate face, his eyes are somewhat sharp and sinister.

    "Who are you? Why are you blocking our way!" Qiong Xiao said coldly.

    "Haha, being ignorant is just being ignorant. None of us know anything about it?" the handsome man sneered.

    "What do you want?" Qiong Xiao asked expressionlessly, her eyes getting colder.

    "You shouldn't be so close to her! There's a price to pay for being too close to her!" The man said with a faint smile.

    "Oh! Really? Are you sure you have these abilities?" Qiong Xiao mocked.

    "Qiong Xiao, this person is the tenth King Xuan on the list!" Li Lang finally recognized him and immediately reminded him.

    "Oh? Number 10 on the Most Popular Ranking, Wang Xuan?" Qiong Xiao asked.

    "Yeah!" Li Lang nodded.

    "Finally someone recognized me!" Wang Xuan stared at Qiong Xiao and smiled.

    "It turns out that he is number 10 on the Most Popular Ranking. I am indeed a bit disrespectful!" Qiong Xiao said with cupped hands.

    "Haha, now that you know it's me, you should know what I'm capable of," Wang Xuan said with a smile on his face, but this smile was very disturbing.

    "You mean this matter must have an outcome. We are also from the Star Empire, so why do you have to push me so hard?" Qiong Xiao intertwined his fingers and asked.

    Wang Xuan nodded with a smile on his face. Looking at the menacing Wang Xuan, Qiong Xiao couldn't help but shook his head, "Beauty is a disaster!"

    "I want the result, but what if I, Qiong Xiao, don't want to do it!"

    "Haha, a person who can't even be on the list of celebrities, what right does he have to tell me that he doesn't want to? Did I discuss it with you?" Wang Xuan sneered.

    "Feng Yun list? I don't care about that thing. As for whether you are qualified or not, you will know after you try it!" Qiong Xiao said expressionlessly.

    "Haha, I will let you know later what life is worse than death. Killing is prohibited in the academy, but it is still okay to torture people!" Wang Xuan looked at Qiong Xiao indifferently.

    "Li Lang! Have you ever beaten that big man?" Seeing that he was about to take action, Qiong Xiao turned to Li Lang and asked.

    "Hehe, even though that big guy is in the late stage of the ** realm, I always feel that he is much stronger than the late ** realm people I encountered. Although I can't beat him, it should still be possible to hold him back!" Li Lang nodded.

    "Haha! Well, let us brothers come and see how valuable this freshman ranking is!" Qiong Xiao laughed.

    Following the tense confrontation between Qiong Xiao and his group, many students were attracted. They were curious about what these people were going to do. Soon Qiong Xiao and the others were surrounded by people.

    "Hey, isn't this Wang Xuan, who is number 10 on the freshman rankings? What does he want to do? Who is he looking at? It seems that he is not on the rankings!" A sentence suddenly popped up from the crowd.

    "Regardless of whether he is on the top rankings or not, among our freshmen who dare to challenge the top ten, he must have some strength," someone else said.

    "Qiong Xiao, you are no match for me. Surrender obediently to avoid suffering!" Wang Xuan said with a ferocious expression.

    "Hmph! I have never backed down since I was a child. It's impossible for me to admit defeat. If you want to fight, fight. Stop nagging! I don't have time to play with you!" Qiong Xiao said indifferently.

    "Looking for death! Ah Lang, the person next to that boy is left to you, deal with him quickly!" Wang Xuan showed a cruel look.
